critique: The mint-on-black string treatment is clean and attractive, and both frames retain recognizable curved parallel strands with bright pinch crossings. Motion is now observable, but it is still too fast and morphing: frame 1 has two broad, spacious twist lobes, while frame 4 has several tightly repeated lobes and extra dotted/crossing strands. That reads as abrupt structural reconfiguration rather than a smooth traveling String Twist. The animation should keep the same sparse, legible string lattice while the existing twist nodes drift gently.

suggestions.why: Greatly reduces Twister Amount phase change so the string topology remains coherent between frames while retaining visible, gentle twist motion.
Stops the additional Flow X travel that is contributing to the rapid multiplication and relocation of wave lobes; the slower Twister animation alone should provide controlled motion.
